description: Average Water Network Capacity by Hexagon Area is a dataset listed in City of Edmonton open data portal (data.edmonton.ca), an open data portal (Socrata) of a city, published or maintained by City of Edmonton. This dataset provides the average water network capacity (2025) within 200m x 200m hexagons, in Litres/second, for the City of Edmonton. Coverage: Edmonton. The portal files it under the category Externally Sourced Datasets. Its tags are average fire flow rate. The table has 4 columns. Attribution on the portal: EPCOR. The portal shows 2025-04-29 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is see the terms of use on the portal (no named licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support drinking water network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-edmonton-ca-portal.
